newsitem.title: USA: Agri-Nutrition sees Q2 charge for deal termination.
newsitem.headline: Agri-Nutrition sees Q2 charge for deal termination.

text.p: Agri-Nutrition Group Ltd said Wednesday it expects to take a charge in its fiscal second quarter that will decrease net income by $150,000.

The charge, which will be taken as non-operating expense, relates to the termination of a letter of intent for its proposed purchase of Anthony Products Co. That proposed deal was first announced in August 1996.

"As a result of a thorough due diligence process, we mutually agreed to terminate discussions with Anthony Products as it became apparent that the timing was not appropriate to maximize the potential of the transaction," Bruce Baker, president, said in a statement.
"On a selective basis, we will now consider other acquisitions and alignment opportunities which had been pending," he added.
Anthony Products specializes in the development and manufacturing of pharmaceutical animal health products.
Agri-Nutrition operates three companies that produce, market and distribute health, grooming and nutritional products for the pet and animal health care industry.
